race.comment: Good race with Coolmore Stud Stakes implications. NATURAL FLING (10) comes back to her own age having started favourite in the G1 Moir Stakes last time and running a brave third behind My Gladiola. 1100m should suit her better and she might just prove too fast for them. Keen to see the return of THE NEXT EPISODE (3) who did give NATURAL FLING a bath when they met at Gold Coast earlier in the year. Jury was out over his Sydney trials but he appears to have jumped out better since. Fancy he'll improve for the run but he's very good. OVER EXCITED (11) was just touched off here last time in the Cap D'antibes. That race was faster than the boys in the Poseidon where MBUBE (7) and BIG SKY (2) ran second and third respectively. MBUBE was well backed there and can improve, as can BIG SKY who was off a decent break.
